Maya — appreciate the fast turn. A few concrete items attached and answers inline below.

Answers / attachments:
- SOC 2: attached "redwood-soc2-summary.pdf" (exec summary + list of controls and auditor). Full report can be provided under NDA; we usually provide it during procurement step.
- Vendor questionnaire: I attached our completed template and marked items where we need clarification. See vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx (tab: Redwood answers).
- Pen test: attached "redwood-pen-test-request-form.docx" — it includes our standard pen-test policy (scope options, credentialing, approved scanners, and disclosure timeline).

On the specific points you asked:
- PHI in tests: we do not provide production PHI for external pen testing; credentialed staging can be configured with synthetic/obfuscated sample data on request. We will list protective controls and data handling in the pen-test scope doc.
- SLA: our standard SLA for externally-reported vulnerabilities is: acknowledge within 24 hours, remediation plan for Critical within 14 days and for High within 30 days (exceptions handled case-by-case). We also offer a faster SLA for Enterprise contracts (can be negotiated).
- Scanning cadence: automated internal SAST/DAST weekly in CI, external network scans monthly, third-party pen test annually or on major releases. We can tighten cadence for regulated customers under contract.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm scope (external-only vs external+staging with creds) and whether we should provision a staging dataset.
2) You upload the HL-filled questionnaire to the Drive link I shared OR return edits in the attached XLS.
3) Connor will loop Security Ops for scheduling the pen-test and confirming remediation routing.

If you confirm scope today, Connor can start the vendor intake and well aim to have a pen-test vendor engaged within 5 business days (subject to contract).

Thanks —
Soojin Lee

Hi Soojin / Team — per Maya, confirming the preferred pen-test scope: external black-box of public APIs + credentialed staging with obfuscated sample data. Target start window: May 6 1 2026. Weve attached a flagged version of your questionnaire with a few follow-ups on encryption-at-rest, key management, and audit log retention. Please confirm whether you can meet the following:

- Acknowledgement SLA: 24 hours (we expect confirmation email when a finding is submitted to us).
- Remediation SLA: Critical  7 days; High  21 days; Medium  60 days. These are our default procurement expectations for PHI-adjacent vendors; we understand negotiable under enterprise terms.
- Disclosure policy: we require coordinated disclosure; we expect a 30-day window after confirmation to allow remediation before public disclosure.

We can be flexible on remediation windows if Redwood provides a compensating control plan. Please return the completed questionnaire (we filled sections where possible) and confirm the SLA items.
